summary: Institutional positioning is aggressively bullish on long-term indices, evidenced by massive $1B+ accumulations in SPX 6000C (exp 2026) and SPXW 5000C (exp 2026) over multiple sessions. Significant directional conviction is visible in SPXW deep out-of-the-money calls, specifically the 8090C, 8100C, and 8070C strikes for Dec 2026, totaling over $946M in single-day premium. While MU and AMD show strong intraday call buying (P/C < 0.30), CAR is seeing extreme downside hedging with a massive 11.29 P/C ratio. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in the SPX/SPXW complex to validate these multi-billion dollar long-dated call positions, while monitoring if the heavy SPX 7150P hedging persists.
